# Sackar Atlas

A structured open dataset documenting historical anti-LGBTIQ hate crimes in Sydney,
derived from the 2023 NSW Special Commission of Inquiry into LGBTIQ Hate Crimes.

- Repo: https://github.com/bitsloppy/sackar-atlas
- Licence: CC-BY 4.0 (data)
- Citation: Roberts A (2026) *Sackar Atlas* [data set], GitHub, https://github.com/bitsloppy/sackar-atlas

## Architecture

The site has three interconnected layers:

1. **Corpus** (`sources/`) — primary source documents with permanent paragraph IDs,
   served as a navigable document library at `/sources/`. Every paragraph is addressable
   via an HTML anchor (e.g. `<span id="5.102">`).

2. **Derived data** (`data/`) — structured records generated by AI from the corpus.
   Every finding field includes a `ref` citing the exact corpus paragraph it came from.
   Anna Roberts audits all AI-generated data before publishing.

3. **Site UI** — case/location pages with reference overlays; corpus reader with
   cross-links to data pages and maps.

## Collections

- `sources/` — primary source documents (corpus layer); SCOI vols, Parrabell, R58, IPTJ
- `data/cases/` — one file per victim (YAML frontmatter + narrative)
- `data/locations/` — places: beats, crime scenes, memorials, police commands
- `data/events/` — strike forces, inquiries, legal milestones, memorials
- `data/people/` — victims, perpetrators, witnesses, investigators, officials
- `data/recommendations/` — the 19 SCOI formal recommendations

## Identifiers

Every record has a slug (lowercase-hyphenated filename). Slugs are used for all
cross-references between records.

Corpus paragraph IDs: `[doc_id].[chapter].[para]` for SCOI volumes (e.g. `SCOI-V2.5.102`),
or `[DOC_ID].[N]` sequential for other documents (e.g. `PFR.247`).
See `sources/PARA-ID-REGISTRY.md` for the full registry.

## YAML field-level citations

Every finding field in case (and other) records carries a `ref` to the corpus paragraph:

```yaml
date_of_death:
  value: 1976-05-11
  ref: SCOI-V2-CAT-A-mark-stewart#5.95

scoi_category:
  value: A
  ref: SCOI-V2-CAT-A-mark-stewart#5.621
```

Identity/admin fields (name, slug, published) do not carry refs.

## Primary sources

The SCOI report is the primary source for all case data. All citations use AGSM author-date.
Primary source documents live in `sources/` with paragraph IDs applied.
Secondary sources (newspaper articles, academic papers) are managed in a Zotero group library.
